result.title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
result.comment: 35 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/Mercor-Intelligence/OpenWorldEngineer ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mercor/OpenWorldEngineer ; leaderboard: https://openworldengineer.mercor.com
result.summary: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. First, when models are given more time, they use more test-time compute and achieve higher scores. Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score. Second, each model scores lower on hidden cases than on the provided cases, by an average of 18 points, which we call the deployment gap. Models also fail to predict the deployment gap, overestimating their performance on hidden test cases by an average of 21 points. We hope that OWE-Bench grounds progress toward agents whose engineering solutions perform as well in deployment as they do in testing.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 OWE-Bench，包含 26 个由领域专家撰写的长时程工程任务（软件、物理工程、机器学习、科学计算），按速度、成本与准确率在可自测的给定用例和隐藏用例上评分，并报告前沿模型在测试时计算扩展与「部署差距」上的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 模型在隐藏用例上平均低 18 分、却高估自身表现约 21 分这一自评失准现象，可能为 LVR 中停止决策与自验证的校准、以及长度/分布泛化评价提供参照，但任务为纯文本工程 agent，与视觉 latent 状态无直接联系，可供核查其评价方式能否迁移。
